demos.title: Watch one request travel the gateway
demos.body: A real prompt, the eight steps it passes through, and the signed row it leaves. The obvious cases are caught in under a millisecond; the ambiguous ones cost a model pass.

demos.title: An agent is about to call a tool
demos.body: Judged three times: when the agent discovers what exists, when it fills in the arguments, and when the server answers back. A poisoned description never reaches the list.

demos.title: What happened, and can you prove it?
demos.figureNote: went back to a person instead of a flat block
demos.body: Every decision with the detector that fired, the control it serves and the request id an auditor would quote — each one read back from the ledger with the chain verified.
